newsitem.title: USA: FULL TEXT-Carter-Wallace rejects Davis bid.
newsitem.headline: FULL TEXT-Carter-Wallace rejects Davis bid.

text.p: Carter-Wallace Inc said on Friday that its majority shareholder, CPI Development Corp, has rejected a tender offer from investor Marvin Davis to buy all outstanding shares for $18 per share. It added that it will take no further action on the bid.
The following is a full text of its news release.

NEW YORK--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Nov. 1, 1996--Carter-Wallace, Inc. (NYSE:CAR) announced today that The CPI Development Corp., the owner of a majority of the outstanding stock of Carter-Wallace for over 50 years, has informed the company that it has no interest in selling its shares in the transaction proposed by Davis Companies to buy all of the outstanding shares of the company at $18 per share.
The company, in light of the position taken by its majority shareholder, has determined that it will not take any further action with respect to the proposal from Davis Companies.
Carter-Wallace, Inc. markets toiletries, proprietary drugs, pharmaceuticals, diagnostic specialties and pet products.
